                                     ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the B3-1 Community Shopping

District symbols as shown on Map No. 7-N

in the area bounded by:



West Belmont Avenue; a line 134.08 feet east of and parallel to North New England

Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Beknont Avenue; and a line 65.00

feet east of and parallel to North New England Avenue.



To those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.




SECTION 2. . This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



Common address of property: 6847-51 West Belmont Avenue, Chicago
